summary: Alabama Forestry Commission's 100 ft Aermotor tower on Lookout Mountain in Cherokee County; register says 1960, a 1964 newspaper item says 1961.

facts.design: 100 ft Aermotor MC-39 with a 7 ft x 7 ft cab

staffing.status: full-time towerman in 1964 (per a 1964 Anniston Star item); later staffing not in the sources read

visit.trail_note: A 1964 item says the site is easily accessible by car; current access is not described in the sources read.

events.note: NHLR: completed by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1960. A 1964 Anniston Star item (via Forest Lookouts) says built in 1961.
Tower erected in 1961 per the Anniston Star, quoted on Forest Lookouts; conflicts with the register's 1960

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says completed in 1960. A 1964 Anniston Star item quoted on Forest Lookouts says the tower was erected or built in 1961. The sources read do not settle which year is right.

sources.title: Daniels Gap, Forest Lookouts (quoting the Anniston Star, October 21, 1964)

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. Build year conflicts: NHLR 1960 vs Anniston Star item (quoted by Forest Lookouts) 1961. The Anniston Star item spells the towerman's name two ways ('Edlers' and 'Elders'); the story uses 'Edlers'. The Forest Lookouts page is a transcription of a newspaper item, not the paper itself. No source read gives the current condition, closure, or access; a search snippet (YouTube) links the tower to Little River Canyon Preserve near Canyon Mouth Park, unverified and not used. Checked NPS pages for Canyon Mouth Park and directions: no mention of the tower. The Alabama state forestry history PDF (forestry.alabama.gov) was searched for Daniel's Gap and had no match in the grep. Check current status with the Alabama Forestry Commission before publishing visit advice.
